entries.en: The surgeon identified the obturator vein on the scan.
entries.zh: 外科医生在扫描图中辨认出了闭孔静脉。

entries.en: Draw an obtuse triangle below the line.
entries.zh: 在线的下方画一个钝角三角形。

entries.en: This obtuse-angled triangle has two equal sides.
entries.zh: 这个钝角三角形有两条相等的边。

entries.en: The replica has a removable occipital bone.
entries.zh: 这个复制模型的枕骨可以拆卸。

entries.en: The study measured activity in the occipital cortex.
entries.zh: 研究测量了枕叶皮质的活动。

entries.en: The diagram colors the occipital lobe green.
entries.zh: 图中把枕叶涂成了绿色。

entries.en: The arrow points toward the occipital protuberance.
entries.zh: 箭头指向枕骨隆突。

entries.en: They labeled the occipital vein in the illustration.
entries.zh: 他们在插图上标出了枕静脉。

entries.en: This skull model clearly shows the occipitomastoid suture.
entries.zh: 这个颅骨模型清楚显示了枕乳突缝。

entries.en: The forecast map showed an approaching occluded front.
entries.zh: 天气预报图显示一道锢囚锋正在靠近。

entries.en: The historian studied books about the occult arts.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家研究了有关秘术的书籍。
